significance: A Thai Theravada temple in Tumpat district, Kelantan, founded in 1973 by the abbot Phra Krurasapia Chakorn and known for its 40-metre reclining Buddha, begun in 1975 and finished in 1979. The grounds also hold an eighteen-armed Avalokiteshvara and a four-faced Phra Phrom, mixing Chinese and Tibetan elements into a Thai temple.
